why: In the review-of-the-finished-work items the account of what happened and the saving of the work as records interleave, and the primary call between reporting (T3-073) and keeping (T3-105) is easy to swap.

why.T3-031: A lone April Fools greeting that plays the room's own running 'nana'd' joke; it stages no false claim as true (T3-001) and carries no canvas work.

why.T3-070: The doing is circulating coordinates, area references, guides and 'follow the same plan' directions for placers to follow, not offering a new mark (T3-033) nor settling its look (T3-004).

why.T3-063: A bot applies the room's routine default flair to canvas posts, which is precisely the bot-assisted handling of canvas posts under standing rules, not gathering them into a thread (T3-015) nor changing the rules (T3-185).

why.T3-196: Former players return to PoE because they saw it on r/place and the room welcomes that return, which is the mark drawing lapsed fans back rather than bringing brand-new outsiders (T3-044).

why.T3-043: The passages manage who is credited for a community pixel art: a maker claims the work and asks an off-site page to name them, which is credit claimed and disputed rather than a lone canvas tribute (T3-092) or a remake in another medium (T3-057).

why.T3-031: Same single-code practice as position 1: an April Fools greeting built on the room's own running 'nana'd' joke, staging no fake as true (T3-001).

why.T3-002: The bulk of the codes rally the room's own members to come and place for the TØP logo ('come contribute', 'need your help', 'help maintain'), which is calling hands to a chosen mark.
why.T3-033: Separate codes offer the room an idea of what to make before any mark is fixed ('Should we do something on /r/place? This is my idea', 'Lets build a kitchen sink', 'Can we make this on r/place').

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-002 carries the rallies for hands to a TØP logo but does not reach the separate act of offering the room an idea of what to make before it is chosen.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1274406 'Should we do something on /r/place? This is my idea' and C0096761 'Can we make this on r/place' offer the room an idea of a mark to make, satisfying T3-033's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-033: drop it and the initial idea-offers fold into the call, which still carries the placement.

why.T3-156: Most codes take the finished picture into the sub's identity: pointing out the new banner, refreshing to see it, the mods making it the new logo, scaling it for the banner.
why.T3-057: Other codes remake the same picture in another medium: an office mural for GGG, asking GGG to make the artwork in the office, a cloak with the banner, calling it the best MTX.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-156 carries the banner being taken into the sub's identity but not the separate remaking of the picture as an office mural or an in-game cloak in another medium.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0588073 asks GGG for an office mural and C1432543 asks for a cloak with the banner, remaking the canvas picture in another medium as T3-057 describes.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-057: drop it and the mural and cloak ideas are lost while the banner-as-emblem placement stands.

why.T3-001: Members stage false April Fools announcements (a new album, fake venues) and others fall for or reveal them; a moderator even deletes the debunking posts, so the room's own fakes are the doing, not testing an outside claim (T3-095).

why.T3-022: The largest share moves and restarts the logo after it is covered or crowded out: 'start over somewhere', 'the void ruined our efforts, we have to start over', 'move it down a bit'.
why.T3-005: Other codes answer an attack under way with calls to hold and fight: 'we can fight back and also expand', 'we're being taken over, we really need to try to expand'.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-022 carries moving and restarting the logo after it is overrun but not the calls to fight back and hold the line against the crowding attackers.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0628239 'I think we can fight back and also expand' and C1088676 'we're being taken over' answer an attack under way, satisfying T3-005's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-005: drop it and the defence calls are lost to the move-and-restart account.

why.T3-037: Members weigh the canvas work and the whole r/place event as worthwhile or worthless, from banner-quality attacks to 'the /r/place thing as a whole seems stupid', which is arguing the canvas's worth rather than objecting that posts flood the sub (T3-075).

why.T3-073: The bulk reports what happened to the work: the three iterations, the slow start that settled into coordination, the mirror chains running out of space, off-pixels, ceded columns and the Flask's fate.
why.T3-105: Separate codes save the work as records, sharing a timelapse and a full 72-hour timelapse.
why.T3-058: Late codes lay blame after the close on named rooms: Denmark's destruction just before the end, Osu deserving destruction, the Void ruining things.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073 carries the account of what happened to the work but not the separate act of saving it as timelapses and shared images.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0124325 'Timelapse of PoE logo in r/place' and C1002848 'Path of exile logo timelapse 72h full' keep the work as it stood, satisfying T3-105's gate.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-105: drop it and the timelapse-sharing is lost while the account of the work stands.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-073 tells what happened but does not carry the blaming of named rooms after the close and the keeping of the grievance alive.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1526573 blames Denmark's destruction just before the end and C1178187 accuses the Void of ruining things while contributing nothing, laying blame on named rooms as T3-058 describes.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-058: drop it and the blame is lost while the account of the work stands.

why.T3-017: A single courtesy 'thank you SmallSubBot!' with no canvas work and no April Fools point, so it is the sub's ordinary side talk rather than a credit to the work's makers (T3-043) or thanks to an allied room (T3-072).

why.T3-038: Hands-on building and progress reports: the circle started with fill directions, reusing existing black for a white outline, 'almost done', the first red block at 404,555, and working together to enlarge the logo, which is building-and-reporting rather than merely sharing a template (T3-070).
